one_liner: Luka Doncic produces 31.9 points, 8.6 assists, and 8.4 rebounds per 36 minutes across the sample.
three_things: The scoring-plus-playmaking load is heavy: 31.9 points and 8.6 assists per 36 minutes.
He rebounds at 8.4 per 36 minutes, high for a lead guard.
Efficiency is solid but not elite: 47.4 percent from the field and 37.3 percent from three.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. A rate says nothing about usage or shot quality.
